song.lyrics:
[V1] .D G Jesus, keep me near the cross .D Bm A7 There a precious fountain .D G Free to all, a healing stream .D A7 D Flows from Calv'ry's mountain
[C1] . G D In the cross, in the cross . A7 D Be my glory ever, ever . G D Till my ransomed soul shall find . A7 D Rest beyond the river
[V2] .D G Near the cross, a trembling soul .D Bm A7 Love and mercy found me .D G There the Bright and Morning Star .D A7 D Sheds its beams a-round me
[V3] .D G Near the cross! O Lamb of God .D Bm A7 Bring its scenes before me .D G Help me walk from day to day .D A7 D With its shadow o'er me
[V4] .D G Near the cross I'll watch and wait .D Bm A7 Hoping, trusting ever .D G Till I reach the golden strand .D A7 D Just beyond the river__
song.title: In the Cross
